dct_title_s: University of Minnesota, Minneapolis: grading plan for mall
dct_alternative_sm: University of Minnesota, Minneapolis: grading plan for mall
dct_description_sm: Site plan in black ink on textile. Shows buildings, roads, paths and sidewalks, parking, drainage, and landscaping, including placement, types, and sizes of trees. "Morell & Nichols, landscape architects and engineers. Minneapolis - Minnesota, 1922. Revised April 1924." "C. H. Johnston, architect." "J. H. Forsythe, consulting architect." "3063-U. Revised April 1924." Partial inscription on verso: "Mall grading plan 3168-U - 1922 - re" Inscription on verso: "Mall dimension plan." Library copy bears pencil markings showing further revisions and placement of additional trees.
104 x 100 centimeters on sheet 110 x 106 centimeters
